meta.clustering: average-linkage agglomerative on cosine distance, 2 levels
meta.note: Positions are LOCAL to this deck and are not atlas positions — the deck is re-laid-out from its own cards, which is the whole point. Anything that draws this must say so.
cartographer_notes: city-1 and city-6 are NOT one landbase split arbitrarily, which is what engine.json's mana stage says ('the map split one landbase into two cities; nothing functional separates them'). Membership disagrees: city-1 holds 22 lands of which 20 make exactly two colours and none deals damage or pays life to tap; city-6 holds every any-colour land (Command Tower, Exotic Orchard, Mana Confluence, Opal Palace, Spire of Industry, Talon Gates of Madara), all three painlands plus City of Brass, and every land with a non-mana ability (Reliquary Tower, Gemstone Caverns, Talon Gates, Raugrin Triome's cycling). I named them apart on that reading; the disagreement with the engine model is itself a finding for the orchestrator.

city-5-hood-1 (Commit // Memory, Faithless Looting, Nezahal, Primal Tide) is left with its deterministic word. The only trait the three share is working from somewhere other than a normal cast — aftermath, flashback, self-exile — and Echo of Eons in hood-0 shares it, so the split does not read cleanly enough to name.

Lightning Greaves and Swiftfoot Boots are the odd members of city-0-hood-0 (TOKENS OFF THE LOOP): they protect a commander and have nothing to do with cycling or discarding. Inside EVERY PITCH PAYS, Elesh Norn // The Argent Etchings and Goblin Engineer look like the map's genuine strays — neither triggers on a card leaving your hand. I did not rename around them.

city-1-hood-2 is a single card, Hengegate Pathway // Mistgate Pathway. It is alone because it is the deck's only modal double-faced land — one colour per face, chosen on the way in — so it is unusual rather than misplaced.

FUND THE NEXT WHEEL is not eight mana sources: Currency Converter is a discard outlet that also banks exiled cards, and Sorcerer Class is a looter whose level 3 is a damage engine. Both cluster with the Treasure makers, and engine.json flags the same cut-across on city-4.

verified_count is 0 on every region. This deck has zero checker-passed stacks, so no name on this map sits on a rules-verified line; engine.json's lines all carry verified_by: null. Nothing in these labels or glosses claims a line works.

Mass: the two landbase cities are 36 of 100 cards. The largest non-land city is CARD BY CARD at 19, then THE SPIN CYCLE at 17 — the deck's mass is the refill machinery plus the per-card conversion built around it, which is what the thesis says it should be.
city-4 has one neighbourhood with membership identical to the city, so it keeps its deterministic word rather than repeating the city's name.

regions.label: CARD BY CARD
regions.gloss: Cycling, looting and discard outlets — the same two payments a wheel makes, one card at a time, every turn.

regions.label: TOKENS OFF THE LOOP
regions.gloss: Three enchantments that turn cycling, discarding and drawing into bodies; the two equipment here are doing a different job entirely.

regions.label: EVERY PITCH PAYS
regions.gloss: Seven of these hand something back for a discarded card — a draw, a copy, damage, or the card itself, played anyway.

regions.label: CYCLED, NOT CAST
regions.gloss: Cycled for the trigger, not cast for the card: one counters a spell, one counters an ability, and both replace themselves.

regions.label: THE DUALS
regions.gloss: Twenty of the twenty-two make two of your colours; this is what casts a double-pip spell on the turn you want it.

regions.label: ALWAYS UNTAPPED
regions.gloss: None of these ever enters tapped; seven charge for the colour another way: a filter, a land type, an extra mana.

regions.label: TAPPED UNLESS
regions.gloss: Each checks something as it enters: a land type, a land count, two life. Ten of the eleven can dodge it.

regions.label: PICK A SIDE
regions.gloss: One face makes white, the other blue. You choose as it enters, and it is a land either way.

regions.label: EVERY DRAW DOES WORK
regions.gloss: Each card drawn fires something else: a token, a ping, a drain — and two of these draw on the table's turns.

regions.label: MORE CARDS, MORE DRAIN
regions.gloss: Five hand you extra cards, two charge the table a life or a damage for each one drawn, and Niv-Mizzet does both.

regions.label: THE TOKEN MAKERS
regions.gloss: Four permanents that pay in bodies rather than cards: a faerie, an insect, a squad of copies, a Blood token.

regions.label: BODIES THAT GROW
regions.gloss: Seven take +1/+1 counters from the draws, discards and hits the rest of the deck is already paying for.

regions.label: PAID ON CONNECTION
regions.gloss: Four want to be unblocked — connecting is what makes the counter or the card. Chasm Skulker grows on draws instead.

regions.label: COUNTERS WITHOUT COMBAT
regions.gloss: Counters from draws, discards and spare mana, no attack needed — and two of them cash the counters back for cards.

regions.label: FUND THE NEXT WHEEL
regions.gloss: Mana for a second spell the same turn; Smothering Tithe turns everyone else's seven new cards into your Treasure.

regions.label: THE SPIN CYCLE
regions.gloss: Empty every hand and refill it. Six of these shuffle or bottom instead of discarding, and a shuffle pays no damage.

regions.label: THE WHOLE TABLE REFILLS
regions.gloss: Eleven of the twelve refill every player, which is why the opponents' new sevens are worth taxing. Tolarian Winds refills only you.

regions.label: REFILL, THEN BURN
regions.gloss: The refill deals the damage itself: one off their hand size, one off cards drawn if you hold three artifacts.

regions.label: THE FIXERS
regions.gloss: Where the third colour comes from, plus the lands that do a second job: hand size, a free opener, a phase-out.

regions.label: MORE THAN MANA
regions.gloss: Seven of the ten make any colour this deck needs; several also do something that is not mana at all.

regions.label: PAID IN DAMAGE
regions.gloss: Perfect colour at one damage a tap — a price a deck that gains life on every draw can afford.
